overview.description: The XFUNDS Large Cap Income ETF (VOOY) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The XFUNDS Large Cap Income ETFs (the Fund) primary investment objective is to seek capital appreciation. The funds secondary investment objective is to seek current income. VOOY was launched on Aug 31, 2026 and is issued by XFUNDS.
